name: @fossil-lang/executor
description: JS/TS wrapper around the fossil-df-wasm wasm-bindgen artifacts (--target web). The DataFusion executor that runs fossil mappings in the browser — lazy-loaded, separate from the LSP @fossil-lang/wasm.
//dependencies: `@fossil-lang/types` is a zero-runtime dependency and carries no code into a bundle: this package re-exports `Channel` and `Scale` from it rather than stating the `channels:` wire shape a second time. The rest of the manifest mirror stays here, beside the run that returns it.
